```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggridges)

library(p8105.datasets)
data("weather_df")
```

```{r}
weather_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = tmax, y = tmin, color = name)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Temperature",
    x = "Max Temperature (C)",
    y = "Min Temperature (C)",
    color = "Location",
    caption = "Data from NOAA"
  ) +
```
